title: E/11821/2016 — Rubamin Ltd vs. Vadodara-ii
text:
In The Customs, Excise & Service Tax Appellate Tribunal
West Zonal Bench At Ahmedabad
E/ROM/10140/2018-SM
Appeal No.E/11821/2016-SM
M/s Rubamin Ltd. Appellant
Vs
C.C.E. & S.T. Vadodara-ii Respondent
Represented by:
For Appellant: Sh. S.R. Dixit (Advocate)
For Respondent: Sh. S.K. Shukla (A.R.)
CORAM:
HON’BLE DR. D.M. MISRA, MEMBER (JUDICIAL)
Date of Hearing/decision:27.03.2018
Misc Order No. M/ 10368 /2018
Per: Dr. D.M. Misra:
Heard both the sides.
2. This application is filed seeking rectification of the mistake
apparent on the face of the order Dated 02.08.2017.
3. The Ld. Advocate Sh. S.R. Dixit for the applicant submits that in
narrating the list of services mentioned at second line of Para 2 of the
aforesaid order, ‘catering service’ and rent-a-cab service and at fifth
line the case law, namely, John Deere India Pvt. Ltd. vs CCE, Pune-III
2016 (41) STR 990 (Tri-Mum) even though argued and dictated, but in
the typed copy of the order, the same has not been found. It is their
request that the order may be rectified accordingly as the credit on
aforesaid services are squarely covered by the aforesaid judgment.
4. Ld. AR for the Revenue has no objection.

2 | P age E / 11 82 1/2 01 6 -SM
5. Consequently, in the order dt.02.8.2017 in the second line of
the aforesaid order, after courier service, the words ‘ catering service
and rent-a-cab service’ and in fifth line after CCE & ST Vodadara
Vs.Haldyn Glass Ltd. and others Vide Order No.A/11924-11951/2017 dt.
30.6.2017, the case law, namely, John Deere India Pvt. Ltd. vs CCE,
Pune-III 2016 (41) STR 990 (Tri-Mum) be added and the Order is
rectified, accordinlgy. MA(ROM) allowed.
(Dictated and pronounced in the open court)
(Dr. D.M. Misra)
Member (Judicial)
Neha
